name: Street vendor
intro: If you sell from a cart, a stall or the roadside, you may still give small udhar to people you know. BolCash helps you remember it without a paper notebook.

uses.title: Small udhar
uses.body: Write down small amounts so you do not forget them.

uses.title: Who still has to pay
uses.body: See in one place who owes you.

uses.title: Daily cash
uses.body: Record the money that comes in and goes out each day.
